stack.nuxt_ui: 4.6.0 (transitive only, via narduk-nuxt-template-layer-core -- not a direct apps/web dependency)

commands.components: find apps/web/app/components -maxdepth 8 -name '*.vue' | wc -l  # directory does not exist
commands.composables: find apps/web/app/composables -maxdepth 8 -name '*.ts' | wc -l  # directory does not exist

local_reimplementations.name: Page header (h1 hero block)
local_reimplementations.notes: Byte-identical class string 'text-3xl font-bold tracking-tight text-stone-900 dark:text-stone-100 mb-2' copy-pasted into 7 of 8 pages (index.vue has its own larger hero variant). Trivial PageHeader extraction candidate.

local_reimplementations.name: Header/nav/footer (layouts/default.vue)
local_reimplementations.notes: Hand-rolled entirely from raw HTML + a few bare Nuxt UI primitives (UNavigationMenu, UColorModeButton, UIcon) rather than narduk-core's LayerAppHeader/LayerAppFooter/LayerAppShell -- this app is on the legacy template-layer-core package, which does not appear to auto-register an equivalent, or the app chose not to use it.

filter_search_bar.notes: Client-side year filter (filteredTimeline computed) over a static timeline array; not a search box.

card_list.notes: Citation/source list rendered as cards; not individually read in full.
Archived-page-snapshot cards; not individually read in full.

lightbox_media.notes: Plain tags only -- no click-to-enlarge/modal/lightbox found (grepped for Modal|dialog|selectedImage|lightbox = 0 hits). Absence noted, not a reinvention.

timeline_feed.notes: Year-grouped event timeline with highlights/evidence sub-lists; the single richest interactive page in the app.

theme_toggle.notes: Not a reinvention -- direct Nuxt UI component.

defect_history.summary: Template-layer exit onto narduk-libs (harmony#87 pattern) -- web foundation contract §4. Tracked under company-hq DECISIONS.md D-WEBFOUND-2 (2026-09-04), parent company-hq#629, extraction tracker narduk-libs#76. Body states: 'tprinvest is template-layer shaped, with 13-15 narduk-nuxt-template-layer-* traces and zero current narduk-libs package pins.'

top_extraction_candidates.name: PageHeader
top_extraction_candidates.why: Identical class string copy-pasted 7 times; a one-prop (title) shared component removes all 7 copies immediately with zero behavior risk.

top_extraction_candidates.name: Exit template-layer-core/seo/analytics/testing onto narduk-core/seo/analytics (already tracked)
top_extraction_candidates.why: tprinvest#50 already tracks this exact migration estate-wide (D-WEBFOUND-2); this lane's component survey is corroborating evidence for that tracker, not a new finding -- the app currently has zero narduk-libs (non-legacy) package pins.

notes: Smallest and lowest-pattern-density of the three L4 repos: a historical-archive marketing/reference site (TPR Investments, L.P., closed 2014), not a data app. No app/components or app/composables directory at all -- just 8 large single-file pages plus one layout. No tables, no pagination, no forms of consequence. Zero direct @nuxt/ui dependency (it arrives transitively via narduk-nuxt-template-layer-core; only UIcon/UNavigationMenu/UColorModeButton/ULink are used, sparingly). The one substantive cross-repo finding: issue #50 explicitly names harmony-hot-sauce#87 as the pattern to follow for exiting the legacy template layers onto narduk-libs, under a live estate program (company-hq D-WEBFOUND-2 / company-hq#629 / narduk-libs#76) -- this is the same migration L4's third repo (harmony-hot-sauce) is already tracking.
